text: The checker never throws on overlap.

I fixed the bug in `src/domain-services/BookingRuleChecker.ts`. I haven't run the failing test itself. Typecheck and drift detection are both clean, and I didn't run `start_app`.

`BookingRuleChecker.check` looked up the overlapping bookings but never did anything with the result, so no overlap was ever rejected. It now throws an Error when the lookup finds any overlap. The error message is "Room <id> is already booked for the requested time range".

`BookingService.changeTime` runs this check before it updates anything, so a rejected change leaves the original booking as it was. I didn't change `BookingService` or `BookingRepository`. The exclude-id comparison in `findOverlapping` is fine, because it excludes only the booking being changed.
